growth_signal.value: Second round in about a year, bigger than the first.

entry.idea: Fast-growing companies struggle with slow, messy accounts, so Light builds software that keeps the books and does much of the accounting work automatically.
entry.lesson: Rebuild the old core system that everything depends on, rather than patching around it.
entry.name: Light

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last
growth.reason: No customer or revenue numbers found, but the second round was bigger than the seed.

market.reason: Every growing business needs accounts, though this targets fast-growing tech firms first.

tech.reason: A new ledger with AI is real engineering, but rivals could copy the approach within a year or two.

sources.title: Early Revolut backer invests in AI-focused finance software startup Light

entry.twist: It replaces the old accounting ledger at the core with a new one built around AI, instead of adding a helper on top.
entry.who_pays: Fast-growing companies pay a subscription to run their finances on it.
entry.why_now: AI can now read invoices and contracts well enough to do work that used to need big finance teams.
